payload.title: No Accept header means no media type
payload.goal: When a request has no Accept header, `mediaType()` returns undefined and `mediaTypes()` returns an empty list, so a server can tell a client that asked for nothing from one that accepts anything.
acceptance: With no Accept header, `mediaType()` is `undefined` and `mediaTypes()` is `[]`.
With a list of available types and no Accept header, `mediaType(list)` still returns the first item.
The existing tests in test/mediaType.js stay exactly as they are.
